definition.proposition: The two costs of the assembled model on clean80 (ternary: A2s vs A2f +9.5%; loops vs unshared depth: A2f vs E24 +3.2%) are mostly in-distribution memorisation capacity: out of corpus (330 SQ99 files) they shrink to about +0.2% and -0.4%, while the assembly gain over the full fusion survives (-11.3%).

scope.dataset: SQ99 out-of-corpus set (330 local Python files, 31 packages) vs code-py-v2 clean80
scope.architecture: A2s, A2f, E27, E24, E20 (200M checkpoints, seeds 2-4)
scope.precision: bf16; ternary via STE where ternary

definition.refutation_criteria: REFUTED if a registered out-of-corpus replication with seed variance in its CI (A2s vs A2f and A2f vs E24, >= 3 seeds) shows a ternary cost >= 5% or a loop cost >= 2%

origin.source: SQ379 (exploratory, unregistered; worker result integrated in v0.5.26)

reason: SQ379: A2s vs A2f +0.22% (per seed -1.21 / +2.13 / ...), A2f vs E24 -0.41% [-0.69, -0.13] (n 2; E24 seed 3 absent), A2s vs E27 -11.26% [-12.02, -10.56], A2f vs E20 +1.65% [+1.21, +2.15]; package-clustered bootstrap CIs over 31 packages, which do not include seed variance. Exploratory: no registered prediction.

limitations.text: Scale compression confound (SQ379 devlog, 'Reading and caveats'): out-of-corpus losses are 1.65-1.9 bits/char, 6-7x the in-corpus ones, so every relative effect is compressed toward 0 there. The causal reading 'memorisation capacity' is therefore not established. The attenuation is differential (the assembly gain keeps about two thirds of its size, -11.3% vs -16.7%, while the ternary cost goes to about 0), which uniform compression alone does not explain, but the hypothesis stays exploratory until SQ400 (seed variance, leave-one-package-out, a repo-held-out slice) and an absolute-difference readout separate the two.

reason: confirmed; scale-compression confound added as a limitation; stays UNVERIFIED (hypothesis)

qual: registered SQ400 met (P1-P7); mechanism not identified
reason: SQ400 (registered in PREDICTIONS.md ~15:20, committed in v0.5.31 at 15:55 before the first SQ400 result at 16:34; run by the side-quest worker): paired-by-seed CIs on the 330-file SQ99 out-of-corpus set. Ternary cost A2s vs A2f +0.42% [-0.92, +1.77] (n 6) vs +8.94% on clean80-300; loop cost A2f vs E24 -1.91% [-3.40, -0.40] (n 6) vs +2.49%; assembly gain A2s vs E27 -11.26% (n 3). All seven registered predictions held, and the main agent's decision rule (ternary CI upper < +3% with clean80 > +5%, AND loop-cost CI including 0 or favouring loops) is met, so C213 changes design priorities. The scale-compression limitation (event 3) cannot explain the loop cost changing sign (compression shrinks effects toward 0 but cannot reverse them). The memorisation mechanism itself is not measured; SQ410's overlap dose-response would test it. Hence PARTIAL, not VERIFIED.

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the event was recorded

reason: Internal-mechanism evidence (SQ441, eval-only, 3 seeds each): swapping the first SWA layer's attention for an exact causal 256-window mean costs, in corpus / out of corpus: E24 0.00% / 0.00%, A2f +0.6 to +0.9% / +0.03 to +0.07%, A2s +3.0 to +5.5% / +0.1 to +0.4%, E27 +6.5 to +7.3% / about 0%. The first layer's content selectivity serves in-corpus recall only, most in the ternary-heavy arms, consistent with C213's memorisation reading. Descriptive (12 windows per slice); status unchanged.
Outside review 2026-11-23 20:52: the SQ441 'recall' reading overreaches on E24.

limitations.text: On the SQ441 evidence (v0.5.55): E24's 0.00% is a consistency check, not evidence, because its first-layer heads are exactly uniform (entropy 5.299 nats, mean distance 111.6) and the swap is then a no-op. The recall reading rests only on the in- vs out-of-corpus contrast in A2s and E27 (up to +7.3% in corpus, about 0% out), which is descriptive, on 12 windows per slice.

reason: SQ435 (registered v0.5.54, UNMATCHED, so descriptive): renaming user identifiers in 1,000 in-corpus clean80 docs (E24 0.24 -> 0.74 bits/char; the out-of-corpus level 1.71 is not reachable) moves the ternary cost +9.52% -> +3.70%, the loop cost +3.13% -> -1.83% (out of corpus -1.90%) and the assembly gain -16.8% -> -12.5% (out of corpus -11.3%). Unfamiliar identifiers reproduce most of the out-of-corpus shift at under half its loss level, consistent with C213's memorisation reading over pure loss-scale compression. Seeds 2-4; the loop CI is wide; status unchanged.
